contract.falsifier: This claim, as evaluated under battery NB-1 (the Spec 054 amendment, as frozen), is falsified if any of the following holds when the frozen battery is run on the frozen arm-1 and arm-2 corpora: (1) either arm-1 positional-strong set (opening or closing) is empty; (2) for either class, fewer than half of arm 1's positional-strong signs are also positional-strong in arm 2 in the same class, through the pinned crosswalk; or (3) the pooled cross-arm overlap of positional-strong signs does not exceed the 95th percentile of the 999-shuffle label-permutation null — the three conditions applied under the precedence rule of the Spec 054 amendment (§5.5).

null.model: label permutation of arm 2's strong-set membership over its classifiable signs (arm 1's sets, the crosswalk table, arm 2's per-class and pooled strong-set sizes held fixed)

precedence.fired_condition: a positional class reappears at less than one half, with the pooled overlap at or below the label-shuffle null's 95th percentile

inputs.label: claim store after the falsifier append

gates.method: the full decision computation run twice over the pinned inputs, seed 44054; canonical-JSON comparison of both arms' battery records and the decision record
gates.name: Determinism

headline_wording: The amended statement is not supported under battery NB-1 as frozen: a positional class reappears at less than one half, with the pooled overlap at or below the label-shuffle null's 95th percentile. This verdict falsifies the amended statement only. It does not falsify Yadav et al. (2010)'s original statement — the original battery's sets cannot be exhibited — and it does not move the parent claim's recorded status.
